title: 光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷
titleEn: Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules
summary: 模組串成一千五百伏特的高壓組串之後，靠近負極的電池與接地的邊框之間有上千伏特的電位差；濕熱的環境下，這個電壓會驅動玻璃裡的鈉離子遷移到電池上，使功率在幾年內掉掉三成——這就是電位誘發衰退。熱斑則是被遮蔭或有缺陷的電池變成負載而發熱。課程定量分析組串的對地電位、漏電流、分流造成的損失、熱斑的功率與紅外線檢測的判讀。
summaryEn: Once modules are strung to fifteen hundred volts, cells near the negative end sit a thousand volts from the earthed frame; in damp heat that voltage drives sodium ions from the glass onto cells, taking three tenths off power within years, potential-induced degradation. Hot spots are shaded or defective cells turned into loads that heat up. The course quantifies string potential to earth, leakage current, loss from shunting, hot-spot power and interpretation of infrared inspection.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 看不見的衰退與看得見的熱點：對地電位、漏電流、分流損失、反向偏壓與紅外線判讀
v30FocusEn: Invisible degradation and visible hot spots: potential to earth, leakage current, shunt loss, reverse bias and infrared interpretation

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「年發電量與性能比」與「組串的對地電位」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "String potential to earth": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「年發電量與性能比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annual yield and performance ratio" is correct?
options: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。
太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。
同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。
optionsEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio.
The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature.
Every module in a string works under the same conditions.
quiz.explanation: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與性能比」如何決定「光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual yield and performance ratio” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。性能比（PR）把所有損失歸併成一個數字：溫度、髒污、遮蔭、線損、逆變器效率與停機，設計良好的大型電廠約為 0.78 至 0.85。同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. PR gathers all losses into one number — temperature, soiling, shading, wiring, inverter efficiency and downtime — and is about 0.78–0.85 for a well-designed utility plant. The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：電位誘發衰退的試驗條件為 60 °C、相對濕度 85%，施加系統電壓 96 小時
steps.observationEn: Project file: The test for potential-induced degradation is 60 °C at 85% relative humidity under system voltage for 96 hours
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與性能比」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual yield and performance ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 年發電量與性能比
knowledge.text: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。性能比（PR）把所有損失歸併成一個數字：溫度、髒污、遮蔭、線損、逆變器效率與停機，設計良好的大型電廠約為 0.78 至 0.85。同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。
knowledge.textEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. PR gathers all losses into one number — temperature, soiling, shading, wiring, inverter efficiency and downtime — and is about 0.78–0.85 for a well-designed utility plant. The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 電位誘發衰退的試驗條件為 60 °C、相對濕度 85%，施加系統電壓 96 小時
knowledge.textEn: The test for potential-induced degradation is 60 °C at 85% relative humidity under system voltage for 96 hours

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與性能比」的模型 E = P_dc·H·PR，依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P_dc·H·PR for "Annual yield and performance ratio", which value is closest to the annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)?
options: 77.9 GWh
156 GWh
optionsEn: 77.9 GWh
156 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 100 MWp、GHI = 1900 kWh/m²、PR = 0.82，得 156 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 100 MWp, GHI = 1900 kWh/m², PR = 0.82 the result is 156 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與性能比」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual yield and performance ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 100 MWp、GHI = 1900 kWh/m²、PR = 0.82，得 156 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 PR 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 100 MWp, GHI = 1900 kWh/m², PR = 0.82 the result is 156 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise PR by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：PR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 171 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising PR by 10% changes the result to 171 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 156 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 PR 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 156 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in PR with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 100 MWp、GHI = 1900 kWh/m²、PR = 0.82，得 156 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 100 MWp, GHI = 1900 kWh/m², PR = 0.82 the result is 156 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: PR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 171 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising PR by 10% changes the result to 171 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與性能比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual yield and performance ratio"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要量到的開路電壓正常，就代表這一串模組沒有問題。
依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If measured open-circuit voltage is normal, the string has no problem.

Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與性能比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual yield and performance ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能驗收要同時約定日射計等級、清潔頻率與溫度修正方法，否則 PR 數字無法比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Performance acceptance should fix pyranometer class, cleaning frequency and temperature-correction method, or PR figures cannot be compared.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。
knowledge.textEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 性能驗收要同時約定日射計等級、清潔頻率與溫度修正方法，否則 PR 數字無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: Performance acceptance should fix pyranometer class, cleaning frequency and temperature-correction method, or PR figures cannot be compared.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61215 地面用太陽光電模組設計驗證與型式認可。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61215 Terrestrial photovoltaic modules – Design qualification and type approval. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「年發電量與性能比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annual yield and performance ratio" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。
optionsEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Every module in a string works under the same conditions.
quiz.explanation: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年發電量與性能比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Annual yield and performance ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。
knowledge.textEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 2005：高效率模組在高電壓下的極化衰退被報導
knowledge.textEn: 2005: Polarisation loss of high-efficiency modules at high voltage was reported

quiz.question: 關於「組串的對地電位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "String potential to earth" is correct?
options: 同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。
玻璃和塑膠是絕緣體，完全不會漏電。
為了減少電流與線損，大型電廠把二三十片模組串成一千五百伏特的組串。
optionsEn: Every module in a string works under the same conditions.
Glass and plastic are insulators and leak no current at all.
To cut current and cable loss, large plants string twenty or thirty modules to fifteen hundred volts.
quiz.explanation: 為了減少電流與線損，大型電廠把二三十片模組串成一千五百伏特的組串。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 組串的對地電位：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: String potential to earth: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「組串的對地電位」如何決定「光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “String potential to earth” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 為了減少電流與線損，大型電廠把二三十片模組串成一千五百伏特的組串。模組的鋁框為了安全必須接地，是零電位；而組串中每一片模組的電池相對於大地的電位，取決於它在串中的位置與逆變器的接地方式。使用無變壓器的逆變器時，組串的兩端大致對稱地浮在正負七百五十伏特；靠近負端的那幾片模組，電池比邊框低了好幾百伏特。就是這個負的電位差，把帶正電的鈉離子由玻璃拉向電池。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To cut current and cable loss, large plants string twenty or thirty modules to fifteen hundred volts. Module frames must be earthed for safety and sit at zero, while the potential of each module's cells relative to earth depends on its place in the string and how the inverter is earthed. With a transformerless inverter the string ends float roughly symmetrically at plus and minus 750 volts, so cells in the few modules near the negative end sit hundreds of volts below their frames. That negative difference is what pulls positive sodium ions from glass toward the cells. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every module in a string works under the same conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

Module frames must be earthed for safety and sit at zero, while the potential of each module's cells relative to earth depends on its place in the string and how the inverter is earthed. With a transformerless inverter the string ends float roughly symmetrically at plus and minus 750 volts, so cells in the few modules near the negative end sit hundreds of volts below their frames. That negative difference is what pulls positive sodium ions from glass toward the cells.

knowledge.text: 誤解：同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 大型電廠的系統電壓為 1,500 V
knowledge.textEn: System voltage of large plants is 1,500 V

quiz.question: 依「組串的對地電位」的模型 U = U_sys / 2，系統電壓 1,500 V、兩極對稱浮接時組串端部的對地電位最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model U = U_sys / 2 for "String potential to earth", which value is closest to the potential to earth at the string end for a 1,500 V system floating symmetrically?
quiz.explanation: U = U_sys / 2；代入 Us = 1500 V，得 750 V（系統電壓 1,500 V、兩極對稱浮接時組串端部的對地電位）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: U = U_sys / 2; with Us = 1500 V the result is 750 V (potential to earth at the string end for a 1,500 V system floating symmetrically). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 組串的對地電位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: String potential to earth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「組串的對地電位」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “String potential to earth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：U = U_sys / 2；代入 Us = 1500 V，得 750 V（系統電壓 1,500 V、兩極對稱浮接時組串端部的對地電位）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Us 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: U = U_sys / 2; with Us = 1500 V the result is 750 V (potential to earth at the string end for a 1,500 V system floating symmetrically). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Us by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Us 增加 10% 時，結果變為 825 V（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Us by 10% changes the result to 825 V (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 750 V（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Us 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 750 V (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Us with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: U = U_sys / 2；代入 Us = 1500 V，得 750 V（系統電壓 1,500 V、兩極對稱浮接時組串端部的對地電位）。
knowledge.textEn: U = U_sys / 2; with Us = 1500 V the result is 750 V (potential to earth at the string end for a 1,500 V system floating symmetrically).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Us 增加 10% 時，結果變為 825 V（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Us by 10% changes the result to 825 V (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「組串的對地電位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "String potential to earth"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測組串正負兩極對地的電壓，並依每片模組在串中的位置比較其功率衰退的程度。
被遮住的電池只是不發電而已。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Voltage of string positive and negative poles to earth is measured, and each module's power loss compared by its place in the string.
A shaded cell simply stops generating.
quiz.explanation: 量測組串正負兩極對地的電壓，並依每片模組在串中的位置比較其功率衰退的程度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Voltage of string positive and negative poles to earth is measured, and each module's power loss compared by its place in the string. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 組串的對地電位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: String potential to earth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「組串的對地電位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “String potential to earth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測組串正負兩極對地的電壓，並依每片模組在串中的位置比較其功率衰退的程度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Voltage of string positive and negative poles to earth is measured, and each module's power loss compared by its place in the string. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統設計要評估接地方式與組串電位分布，對敏感的模組採負極接地或夜間電位補償。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assess earthing and string potential distribution in system design, using negative earthing or night-time potential compensation for sensitive modules.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電廠裡功率衰退最嚴重的模組全部集中在各組串的負極端，而正極端的模組幾乎完好。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The worst-degraded modules in a plant all cluster at the negative end of strings while those at the positive end are almost untouched. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「組串的對地電位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "String potential to earth" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
玻璃和塑膠是絕緣體，完全不會漏電。
電廠裡功率衰退最嚴重的模組全部集中在各組串的負極端，而正極端的模組幾乎完好。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Glass and plastic are insulators and leak no current at all.
The worst-degraded modules in a plant all cluster at the negative end of strings while those at the positive end are almost untouched.
quiz.explanation: 電廠裡功率衰退最嚴重的模組全部集中在各組串的負極端，而正極端的模組幾乎完好。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The worst-degraded modules in a plant all cluster at the negative end of strings while those at the positive end are almost untouched. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.titleEn: String potential to earth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「組串的對地電位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “String potential to earth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電廠裡功率衰退最嚴重的模組全部集中在各組串的負極端，而正極端的模組幾乎完好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「光電模組電位誘發衰退與熱斑診斷」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: The worst-degraded modules in a plant all cluster at the negative end of strings while those at the positive end are almost untouched. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Potential-Induced Degradation and Hot-Spot Diagnosis in PV Modules”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：就是這個負的電位差，把帶正電的鈉離子由玻璃拉向電池。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That negative difference is what pulls positive sodium ions from glass toward the cells.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一串裡的每一片模組，工作條件都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
